alt: The exterior of Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara showing the iconic red batwing logo tightly wrapped in a white tarp, the distinctive two-wing silhouette still clearly visible through the covering despite FIFA's clean-venue rules
story: FIFA's 'clean venue' rule forced Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara to wrap its iconic batwing logo in a white tarp for the World Cup — but the tarp preserved the logo's distinctive silhouette so perfectly that the covered version went viral worldwide, becoming more recognisable than the original.
why_funny: A rule designed to erase a brand from billions of TV screens instead turned that brand into the most-discussed logo at the tournament — Levi's even swapped their Instagram profile picture to the covered version.
